```{=html}
<section class="accessibility-section">
  <div class="ad-page-container">
    <div class="page-section u-mb-3">
      <h1 class="section-heading">Accessibility Statement</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Conformance target, known issues, and how to report a barrier</p>
    </div>

    <div class="page-section u-mb-3">
      <h2>Conformance Target</h2>
      <p>
        AffineDrift targets <strong>WCAG 2.1 Level AA</strong> across the rendered site. Every route is
        checked with an automated <code>@axe-core/playwright</code> scan (desktop-small viewport, light
        theme) plus a hand-written WCAG AA text-contrast check in both the light and dark themes
        (<code>tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.js</code>). This is a target we are actively working toward,
        not a certification of full conformance.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="page-section u-mb-3">
      <h2>Known Issues</h2>
      <p class="page-note">
        <strong>Status: Partial conformance.</strong> The first full-site scan found 247 serious/critical
        axe-core violations across 163 of 238 routes, concentrated in inline-text link contrast, ARIA
        misuse on video embeds and collapsed accordions, and a scrollable table missing a
        keyboard-focusable wrapper. The CI axe-core check currently runs in report-only mode while these
        are remediated.
      </p>
      <p>
        For the full inventory and remediation status, see
        <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4139" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">issue #4139<span class="sr-only">(opens in a new tab)</span></a>.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="page-section u-mb-3">
      <h2>Reporting a Barrier</h2>
      <p>
        If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this site, please report it through one of the
        channels on the <a href="contact.html">Contact</a> page: open a
        <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/new" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GitHub Issue<span class="sr-only">(opens in a new tab)</span></a>
        (preferred — public and trackable) or email
        <a href="mailto:dieterolson@AffineDrift.com?subject=Accessibility%20Barrier">dieterolson@AffineDrift.com</a>.
        Please include the page URL, the assistive technology or browser you were using, and a
        description of the problem.
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
